notes.title: Game Mechanic Update
notes.notes:
In the new update, we have implemented a new game mechanic:

[b]New Game Mechanic:[/b]
With the new game mechanic, you will need to activate stuff around the map to escape. These things will be spread, and you will have to find them yourself.

Happy new update!

Cheers, Mongo Game Studio.
